Where your hours are going right now — and what I take instead.

Every engagement starts with your calendar and inbox, then expands into whatever is genuinely slowing you down. No task is too small to hand off.

01

Inbox & calendar

Daily inbox triage, scheduling, and meeting prep, so you open your calendar to a day that's already been thought through.

02

Client & customer support

First-line replies, ticket handling, and onboarding emails written in your voice, with clear escalation when something needs you directly.

03

Travel & event coordination

Bookings, itineraries, and vendor follow-ups for trips, offsites, and client events, confirmed and double-checked before you have to think about it.

04

Content scheduling

Queuing and posting across your social channels from a content calendar we build together, with captions lightly edited for each platform.

05

Research & data entry

Vendor comparisons, lead lists, and spreadsheet clean-up delivered in a format you can actually use, not a wall of raw notes.

06

Project coordination

Keeping tasks, deadlines, and handoffs visible across your team, chasing the things that would otherwise stall in someone's inbox.

Hi, I'm Ivy —

I've spent close to four years working directly with founders and small teams as their virtual assistant — inbox, calendar, client threads, and the details nobody notices until they go wrong.

I keep things personal instead of ticket-based. You get one person who learns how you think and adapts to your workflow, not a rotating help desk.

I keep a light caseload on purpose — usually four clients at a time — so every inbox I touch actually gets my attention.
